```{r load packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(readxl)

library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

library(Kendall)

# Check working directory
getwd()
```


```{r import data set, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Import the data set
Electricity <- read_excel(
  path = "./Data/Raw/load.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = TRUE
)

# Check the N/A 
sum(is.na(Electricity))

# Format the hourly data set
Hourly_Electricity <- Electricity %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("h"), 
               names_to = "hour", 
               values_to = "Hourly_demand") %>%
  mutate(Hour = as.numeric(sub("h", "", hour))) %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date), 
         Month = month(Date), 
         Day = day(Date)) %>% 
  select(Date, Year, Month, Day, Hour, Hourly_demand)
 
# Format the data set 
Electricity_Processed  <- Electricity %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%
  mutate(demand = rowMeans(select(., h1:h24), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  select(date, demand)

# Save in the processed folder 
write.xlsx(Electricity_Processed, "Data/Processed/Electricity_Processed.xlsx")

```

```{r transform data into time series}
# Transform into multiple time series object
ts_Electricity_Processed <- msts(Electricity_Processed$demand, 
                                 seasonal.periods = c(30,365))

# Plot
plot_grid(
autoplot(ts_Electricity_Processed),
autoplot(Acf(ts_Electricity_Processed, lag.max=40, plot=FALSE)),
autoplot(Pacf(ts_Electricity_Processed, lag.max=40, plot=FALSE)),
nrow=1
)
```

```{r decompose}
# Decompose the time series
decomp_Electricty_Process <- decompose(ts_Electricity_Processed)
plot(decomp_Electricty_Process)
```
